disclaimers: Hypothetical inputs, not Goldman Sachs model outputs, deployment quotes or scientifically calibrated cooling forecasts.
SRM does not remove atmospheric CO2 and does not earn carbon removal credits.
Costs exclude environmental and regional climate damages, global governance and liability, R&D, independent verification and operational emissions.
LCOE includes generation capital/operating costs; do not add generation capex as a second separate cost.
Marine non-energy annual costs exclude the power generation already covered in the LCOE.
A physical cost sensitivity is not a probability distribution, investment revenue forecast or policy authorization.
